assessor: project root agent; not an independent human assessor
scoringTime: after all sessions; key and task definitions frozen before sessions
partialPolicy: Correct conclusion with wrong protocol scope, unsupported action chronology, or verifier accepting the tested tamper is partly_correct. Navigation hints are retained; substantive hints excluded from unassisted counts.
criticalMisunderstandingDefinition: Treating feedback, missing observations, score or checksum as proof of physical repair/zero methane. Other factual/protocol errors are graded separately.
